name: gads_list_campaigns
description: List all campaigns in your Google Ads account. Returns campaign names, IDs, statuses, budgets, and types. Use to overview account structure or find a campaign ID for detailed analysis.

status.description: Filter by campaign status (optional, returns all if omitted)

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default 50)

name: gads_get_campaign
description: Get detailed settings for a specific campaign. Returns name, status, budget, bidding strategy, and configuration. Use to review or audit a campaign's current setup.

name: gads_campaign_metrics
description: Get performance metrics for campaigns over a date range. Returns impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, CTR, and CPC. Use to analyze campaign effectiveness or compare performance trends.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to filter (optional, returns all campaigns if omitted)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 50)

name: gads_list_ad_groups
description: List ad groups within a campaign by campaign ID. Returns ad group names, IDs, statuses, and CPC bids. Use to explore campaign structure or select an ad group for analysis.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to list ad groups for

limit.description: Maximum number of ad groups to return (default 50)

name: gads_search
description: Run custom GAQL queries against Google Ads data. Use for advanced analysis—filter by keywords, matching types, or aggregate metrics by custom dimensions.

query.description: GAQL query string (e.g., "SELECT campaign.name, metrics.clicks FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS")
